tei:div.tei:p: rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur/ /mngon bstan gshin rje'i gshed nyid la/ /btud nas bka' bsgo'i rnam gzhag bshad/ /'di la gnyis/ bka' sgo'i don spyir bstan pa dang*/ bya tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bka' bsgo zhes pa'i don ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni dper na bla dpon sogs che bas g.yog lta bu chung ba la bya ba 'di dang 'di gyis/ 'di dang 'di ma byed ces bsgos nas dam bca' khas len du 'jug pa lta bu ste/ de la bla mas slong ma la dam tshig khas len du 'jug pa'i sgo nas bka' bsgo ba dang*/ gsang 'dus kyi srung 'khor skabs zhe sdang rdo rjes gnod mdzes la bgegs rnams bzung la khug cig ces bka' bsgo ba dang*/ bde mchog gi srung 'khor rgyas pa'i skabs gnod mdzes kyis khro bcu la bka' bsgos te 'gegs la phur bu gdab pa dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi phyogs skyong dgug bskyed kyis skabs gtso bos rang nyid kyis spros pa'i gshin rje gshed la bgegs bzung nas dgug pa dang phur bu thob cig ces pa dang*/ las tshogs dang bskang gso dang zor 'phen pa lta bu'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu gtso bos las gshin sogs kyi chos skyong la bka' bsgo ba dang*/ gsang 'jigs sogs kyi sa chog ga skabs su gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ zhes sogs kyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba dang*/ rab gnas dang kun rig gi srung 'khor dang lho sgo sogs kyi sngon du hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ zhes sogs kyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba dang/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi sa chog gi skabs su yang hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba lta bu sogs mang ngo*/ /da lta nad pa la bka' bsgo byed ces pa ni/ nad pa nyid la bka' bsgo ba min gyi nad pa'i ched du chos skyong sogs la nad pa 'di'i gnod pa zlog pa dang nad zhi ba dang srung bar gyis shig ces bsgo ba yin no/

/'on kyang nad pa la bka' bsgo byed pa'i tshe bla ma yi dam sogs spyan drangs nas de la gsol ba btab ste nad gdon zhi ba'i ched du byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ bka' bsgor btags pa tsam dang bka' bsgo'i yan lag yin gyi/ bka' bsgo dngos min te/ bka' bsgo zhes pa'i sgra de na sngar bshad pa ltar/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la che chung yod med gang yin kyang 'jig rten grags pa dang mthun par che bas chung ba zhig la 'di ltar gyis shig ces bka' bsgo ba yin gyi/ chung bas che ba la bka' bsgo zhes pa ni grags pa don mthun la mi 'thad do/ /'on kyang tshul de ltar byar rung ba ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /spyir gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs dang rigs gsum mgon po lta bu'i lha khyad par can gyi nga rgyal bzung nas chos skyong gang 'dod pa de spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am nad pa sogs kyi spyi bor bzhugs par mos nas bka' bsgo byed pa 'thad cing*/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i gtso bo phan tshun dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal la gnas nas rta mgrin dang 'jigs byed lta bu la gsol gdab dang byin 'beb bya bar rung yang*/ de dag la bka' bsgo byed na ni cung mi 'brel zhing*/ nad pa nyid la bka' bsgo ba min pa ni bshad pa ltar ro/ /'jigs byed rta mgrin phyag rdor gyi nga rgyal bzung nas mgon chos lha mo rnam sras be tse sogs kyi chos skyong spyan drangs nas nad gdon zhi ba'i bka' bsgo ba ni shin du rung zhing*/ khyad par du 'jigs byed kyis las gshin sogs dang*/ rta mgrin gyis mgon po/ lha mo/ beg tse/ tha 'og pa dang*/ phyag rdor gyis nga rgyal gyis rnam sras dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu lta bu la bka' bsgo byas na skabs dang 'brel lo/ /yang dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis rang gi las byed pa'i lha la nad gdon sogs zhi ba'i ched du bka' bsgo ba'ang rung ste/

mtshon na zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs mthar byed dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal gyis ral gri gshin rje gshed la bka' bsgo na ni 'brel zhing rung bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bya tshul bshad pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa der skad cig gis bskyed nas thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos nas bsrung bya'i nad gdon zhi ba'i gsol gdab lan gsum byas pa'i mthar nad pa sogs la bstims nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ de nas bsrung bya'i spyi bor chos skyong bskyed nas dgug gzhug byas kyang rung yang*/ 'jug pa bde chen rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis chos skyong gang 'dod pa de spyan drangs nas bsrung bya'i steng phyogs sam mgor bzhugs par bsams te/ mngon rtogs mdor bsdus kyis gsal gdab pa'am bsdu na ma byas kyang rung*/ de nas chos skyong de'i sngags lan bdun la sogs pa ci 'grub brjod de /bka' bsgo ba dang phreng ba bsrung bya'i mgo dang rgyab sogs la byin rlabs kyi tshul du rdeg cing*/ de lta bu'i tshul du lan gsum byas nas chos skyong de'i sngags brjod pa dang de'i sku las rang 'dra du ma byung nas bsrung bya'i lus la zhugs pas nad gdon thams cad bskrad pa dang zhi bar gyur par bsams shing*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir sngags brjod cing chos skyong gi thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las 'od zer 'phros bsrung bya'i lus kyi cha thams cad nas zhugs pas lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad lus kyi cha thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ de nas phu btab pas 'od du zhu nas bsrung bya la thim pas bsrung bya'i sgo gsum dang chos skyong gi sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i srung bar gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam/ yang na/ dang por chos skyong spyan drangs nas bsrung bya'i spyi bor bzhugs par mos nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas bla ma yi dam sogs nam mkhar spyan drangs nas gsol gdab sogs byas rjes chos skyong bskyed nas snying po bzla ba sogs sngar bzhin byas pa'i mthar bstim/ de nas slar 'od zer gyis nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i skyabs gnas thams cad spyan drangs nas 'od kyi rnam par bstim yang rung ngo*/ /de ni cung zad rgyas pa yin la/ bsdus pa la ni chos skyong spyan drangs nas bka' bsgo lan gsum byas nas bstim pas kyang 'thus shing*/ der ma zad rang 'jigs byed du bskyed nas gzhan spyan 'dren gzhan med par bla ma yi dam sogs byin rlabs zhu zhing gtang ba tsam la bka' bsgo'i tha snyad byas pa'ang 'dug ste mi 'thad pa mi snang ngo/ /mthar bgegs bskrad par 'dod na las sngags gang yin pa dag a mṛ ta'am khros nu'i sngags kyi mjug te sumbha'i sngags lan gsum mam gcig brjod de/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi mthu byin gyis/ /zhes sogs sam/ /rta mgrin yin na/ rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal ba'i mthu byin gyis/ zhes pa lta bu yi dam gang yin pa de dang der bsgyur nas/ gnod pa ma byed cing*/rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā zhes brjod cing bsrung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ 'jigs byed dang las gshin la brten pa'i bka' bsgo rgyas pa'i phyogs gcig ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ nas/ skur bzhengs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje yab yum spyan drangs/ gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam gling lho yi phyogs/ /nas/ gshegs su gsol/ /ya ma rā dza ā karaṣa ya dza dza dzaḥ bsrung bya'o spyi bor byon nas bzhugs par gyur/

gsal 'debs na/ bsrung bya'i spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i gdan la las kyi gshin rje nag po ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ g.yas thod dbyugs 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas te bsdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ ling ga dmar po gyen du bsgreng ba/ de'i g.yon tu tsa mu ṇḍi nag mo g.yas rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa zung gcig tu gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ /mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ na mo ya mānta ka sarba gu ru bungngha bo nghi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra bhyaḥ mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /na mo/ /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis =/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis =/ yi dam rgyal pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis=/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis= /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis =/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das dpa' rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis =/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis=/ khyed rnams kyis bsrung bya 'di rnams sam/ 'di'i nad gdon bar chad thamasacad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig /ces lan gsum mam/ spro na steng gdon gza' dang dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bar gdon rgyal po'i gnod pa dang*/ thab 'khyams gdon 'khyams rgyal 'gong la sogs pa'i mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

gzhan yang bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang*/ lo skeg zla skegazhag skeg dus skeg na skeg /'chi skeg la sogs pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ de dag las srung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs rgyas par mdzod cing*/ rtsa sngags brjod de/ rgyas bsdus gang rigs lan gsum bya/ de nas chos rgyal yab yum gnyis kyi sngags lan bdun nam gsum re brjod de/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum khyed kyis bsrung bya 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nad gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig de dag las srung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam*/ rgyas par ni sngar ltar bya'o/ /yang sngags gnyis brjod de/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum gyi thugs ka nas chos rgyal yab yum du ma byung ste bsrung bya'i lus kyi cha thams cad nas zhugs/ nad gdon thams cad bskrad cing zhi bar byas/ sngags brjod pas chos rgyal yam yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsrung bya'i lus la phog pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang*/ sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur phu btab pas chos skyong 'od du zhu nas bsrung bya'i spyi bo nas lus la thim pas bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum dang chos rgyal yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur pa'i sgo nas srung zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras bcas spyan drangs/ 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas bsrung bya'i lus la thim pas byin gyis brlabs/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i bsrung ba chen por gyur ces brjod cing*/

rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i zhes sogs sngar ltar bya/ bgegs bskrad par 'dod na thog mar yang rung zhing*/ 'di byed na las sngags sam/ khatga bhṛ ka dang*/ badzra a mṛ ta'i mjug tu sumbhu ni lan gsum mam gcig brjod cing*/ yungs dkar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug kyang legs shing*/ de nas rgyal ba sras bcas sogs brjod de bden byin gyis bsrung ba bya'o/ /mgon po'i bka' bsgo byed na/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis shar lho bsil ba'i tshal nas ye shes kyi mgon po sbyan drangs nas bsrung bya'i spyi bo'i nam mkhar ram spyi bor bzhugs par bsams nas gsal 'debs pa'am min yang rung zhing*/ chos rgyal gyi dod la ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyas par ni mgon po'i bla brgyud kyi mtshan dang*/ mgon po'i sngags brjod cing na mo bu ddha ya/ na mo gu ru he/ zhes pa nas/ 'dugs 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing gzhan sngar ltar la/ 'on kyang rgyas pa la skyabs yul du bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems sogs spyan 'dren cing/ bsdus pa la dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ de bzhin du lha mo/ rnam sras/ beg tse sogs chos skyong gang 'dod pa de spyan drangs nas/ rang rang gi sngags dang mtshan brjod cing byin rlob byed pa sogs rigs 'gros kyis bsgyur rung ngo/ /gzhan yang dam pa kha cig gi gsung 'bum las 'jigs byed/ chos rgyal/ rta mgrin gsum gyi sgo nas bka' bsgo byed tshul zhig bshad pa 'dir bkod na/ dang po 'jigs byed kyi bka' bsgo ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ de nas/ hriḥṣtīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams sam slob ma'i spyir bor sna tshogs padma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag

zhal dgu phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i gshin rje gshed kyi ye shes pa sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs gyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ya mānta ka a rghaṃ nas/ shabta pra tī tstsha swā hā/ gzugs mchog mchog tu sogs kyis bstod cing*/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos byin gyis rlobs shig /ye shes kyi mkhas 'gro mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig / phyogs bcu dus gsum dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad =/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams sam bsrung bya 'di dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs la gnyer du gtad pa yin pas/ slob ma 'di rnams sam 'di la nyin mtshan dus drug tu g.yel ba med par gzigs nas steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal 'gong*/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag la sogs pa gdon bgegs 'byung po mi ma yin gyi gnod pa/ sa chu me rlung 'khrugs pa sogs 'byung po'i gnod pa/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs nang gi 'byung ba'i gnod pa thams cad las srung bar mdzod/ skyabs par mdzod/ spa bar mdzod/ tshe bsod rgyas shing lus sems bde bar mdzod/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃḥṣtī dang*/ rtsa sngags brjod/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'od du zhu nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas yi dam kyi sku gsung thugs dang bsrung bya'i sgo gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ nas/ hūṃ ges mtshan par gyur pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

bsrung bya'i sha skyi lpags mtshams thams cad 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gtams/ phyi nang gi gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa'i srung ba chen por byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi mthu stobs kyis nas/ gnod pa ma byed cing*/ rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ zhes brjod par bshad/ spyir 'jigs byed rang gis rang la bka' bsgo ba cung mi 'brel ba ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar yin yang*/ 'dir ni 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal gyis bla ma yi dam sogs la byin rlabs zhu ba dang*/ 'jigs byed nyid la slob ma'am bsrung bya gtad nas srung skyob byed par bskul la bka' bsgo ba'i tha snyad mdzad pa tsam yin pas mi 'gal bar sems so/ /gnyis pa chos rgyal gyi bka' bsgo ni/ rang 'jigs byed du bskyed nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkha' sbyan drangs/ oṃ kṣa la rū pa sa pā ri wa ra argha sogs kyis mchod/ 'jam dpal bka' nyan mas bstod la /dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams kyis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ grub chen dpa' bo rdo rje/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha ba chen po yab sras la sogs pa'i rtsa ba rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bsgos/ dam tshig gnyer du gtad/ rang gis khas blangs pa rnams thugs kyis dgongs par mdzod la/ bdag gi rdo rje slob ma'i 'di khyod rnams la gnyer du gtad pa yin pas/ de nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar nyin gsum gyi bya ra/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzad nas phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/

'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bar gdon btsan dang rgyal 'gong sogs mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang*/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad las srung bar mdzod/ skyob bar mdzod/ spa bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig /oṃ kā la rū ba hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs brjod pas/ thugs rgyud bskul bas chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsrung bya'i skye bo nas thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ chos skyong 'od du zhu nas bsrung bya'i spyi bo nas thim par gyur/ 'on kyang 'jig rten pa'i lha 'ga' zhig lus la bstim mi rung bas dpyad/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i mthu stobs kyis/ /zhes sogs bya'o/ /'di la bka' bsgo'i don tshang ngo*/ /gsum pa rta mgrin gyi bka' bsgo ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs rta mgrin gang mos su bsgoms nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs /phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod tshogs 'bul/ /sdig bshags dge la rjes yi rangs/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin kyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis=/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /dpa' po dang rnal 'byor ma rnams=/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad=/ khyad par du yang dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig khyed rnams la mkhyen brtse nus gsum bsams gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas/ slob ma'am bsrung bya'i de rjes su bzung nas phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las srung bar mdzod/

skyob bar mdzod/ sba bar mdzod/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags la sogs pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ rta mgrin gyi sngags lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros nas bsrung bya la phog pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ /sha spyi lpags mtshams thams cad 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur nas/ gdon bgegs sogs gnod byed gang gis kyang ma tshugs pa'i srung ba chen pos byin gyis brlabs/ dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas bsrung bya'i lus la thim par gyur/ bla ma dkon mchog sogs dang*/ padma dbang gi rgyal po'i mthu stobs kyis/ zhes pa nas/ ma byed cing/ /rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'di yang rta mgrin la byin rlabs zhu zhing gsol gdab byed pa la bka' bsgo'i tha snyad byas pa ste/ gzhan du na rta mgrin rang gis rang la bka' bsgo ba mi legs pa ni sngar ltar ro/ /de lta bu la sogs pa bka' bsgo la dngos btags yod pa'i shes par bya zhing*/ gzhan la phan na ni dngos btags la khyad par chen po mi snang ngo/ /chos skyong la bka' bsgo ba ni rang nyid 'jigs byed lta bu'i yi dam khyad par can gyi bsnyen grangs mthar phyin pa'am/ min yang bsnyen pa dga' rab song ba dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan po ma byung yang cung zad 'dzin shes na legs kyi/ sngon du bsnyen pa gang yang ma byas shing lha'i nga rgyal 'dzin mi shes na ni chos skyong la bka' bsgos nas bskul dka' bas/ de las ni gsol gdab byin rlabs zhu ba'i bka' bsgo btags pa ba byas na legs par sems so/ /grub pa thob pa'i gang zag gi bka' bsgos na nad gdon chen po yang zhi nus mod/ de lta bu min pas nad gdon phra mo 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ chen po zhi bar byed nus pa dka' yang dgos pa yod do/

/bka' bsgo khyad par can la ni mkhas pa'i yon tan yod tsam gyis mi chog gi /chos skyong sogs mthu bo che rnams la bka' bsgo na ni sgom bzlas kyi nus pa cung zad thon dgos la/ gsol 'debs dang byin rlabs zhu ba'i bka' bsgo btags pa ba la ni dad mos chen po yod pas kyang 'grub bo/ /de ltar na bka' bsgo la byed tshul dang rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /bka' ram gsar bu 'ga' zhig dang*/ nad pa sogs la'ang phan gdags phyir/ bka' bsgo spyi dang bye brag gi /rgyas bsdus rnam gzhag cung zad bshad/ ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis lag dal las don gnyer can 'ga' rer phan 'dod kyi bsam pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni rig gnas du ma la blo rgyas pa'i dka' chen blo bzang dbang phyug go/ //maṅga laṃ//
